title: The Dark Knight
filmingLocation: Chicago, Illinois, USA
description: When a menace known as the Joker wreaks havoc and chaos on the people of Gotham, Batman, James Gordon and Harvey Dent must work together to put an end to the madness.

title: The Shawshank Redemption
filmingLocation: Mansfield Reformatory - 100 Reformatory Road, Mansfield, Ohio, USA
description: A banker convicted of uxoricide forms a friendship over a quarter century with a hardened convict, while maintaining his innocence and trying to remain hopeful through simple compassion.

title: Inception
filmingLocation: Fortress Mountain, Kananaskis Country, Alberta, Canada
description: A thief who steals corporate secrets through the use of dream-sharing technology is given the inverse task of planting an idea into the mind of a C.E.O., but his tragic past may doom the project and his team to disaster.

title: Fight Club
filmingLocation: 240 North Neptune Avenue, Los Angeles, California, USA
description: An insomniac office worker and a devil-may-care soap maker form an underground fight club that evolves into much more.

title: Interstellar
filmingLocation: Iceland
description: When Earth becomes uninhabitable in the future, a farmer and ex-NASA pilot, Joseph Cooper, is tasked to pilot a spacecraft, along with a team of researchers, to find a new planet for humans.

title: Pulp Fiction
filmingLocation: 1435 Flower Street, Glendale, California, USA
description: The lives of two mob hitmen, a boxer, a gangster and his wife, and a pair of diner bandits intertwine in four tales of violence and redemption.

title: Forrest Gump
filmingLocation: Chippewa Square, Savannah, Georgia, USA
description: The history of the United States from the 1950s to the '70s unfolds from the perspective of an Alabama man with an IQ of 75, who yearns to be reunited with his childhood sweetheart.

title: The Godfather
filmingLocation: Forza d'Agrò, Messina, Sicily, Italy
description: The aging patriarch of an organized crime dynasty transfers control of his clandestine empire to his reluctant son.

title: The Matrix
filmingLocation: Nashville, Tennessee, USA
description: When a beautiful stranger leads computer hacker Neo to a forbidding underworld, he discovers the shocking truth--the life he knows is the elaborate deception of an evil cyber-intelligence.

title: The Lord of the Rings: The Return of the King
filmingLocation: Hinuera Valley, Matamata, Waikato, New Zealand
description: Gandalf and Aragorn lead the World of Men against Sauron's army to draw his gaze from Frodo and Sam as they approach Mount Doom with the One Ring.

title: Django Unchained
filmingLocation: Evergreen Plantation - 4677 Highway 18, Edgard, Louisiana, USA
description: With the help of a German bounty-hunter, a freed slave sets out to rescue his wife from a brutal plantation owner in Mississippi.

title: The Lord of the Rings: The Fellowship of the Ring
filmingLocation: Wellington, New Zealand
description: A meek Hobbit from the Shire and eight companions set out on a journey to destroy the powerful One Ring and save Middle-earth from the Dark Lord Sauron.

title: The Dark Knight Rises
filmingLocation: Mehrangarh Fort, Jodhpur, Rajasthan, India
description: Bane, an imposing terrorist, attacks Gotham City and disrupts its eight-year-long period of peace. This forces Bruce Wayne to come out of hiding and don the cape and cowl of Batman again.

title: The Wolf of Wall Street
filmingLocation: Portofino, Genoa, Liguria, Italy
description: Based on the true story of Jordan Belfort, from his rise to a wealthy stock-broker living the high life to his fall involving crime, corruption and the federal government.

title: Se7en
filmingLocation: Pacific Electric Building, Los Angeles, California, USA
description: Two detectives, a rookie and a veteran, hunt a serial killer who uses the seven deadly sins as his motives.

title: The Lord of the Rings: The Two Towers
filmingLocation: Hinuera Valley, Matamata, Waikato, New Zealand
description: While Frodo and Sam edge closer to Mordor with the help of the shifty Gollum, the divided fellowship makes a stand against Sauron's new ally, Saruman, and his hordes of Isengard.

title: Schindler's List
filmingLocation: Auschwitz-Birkenau Concentration Camp, Oswiecim, Malopolskie, Poland
description: In German-occupied Poland during World War II, industrialist Oskar Schindler gradually becomes concerned for his Jewish workforce after witnessing their persecution by the Nazis.

title: The Godfather Part II
filmingLocation: Kaiser Estate - 4000 W Lake Blvd, Homewood, Lake Tahoe, California, USA
description: The early life and career of Vito Corleone in 1920s New York City is portrayed, while his son, Michael, expands and tightens his grip on the family crime syndicate.

title: The Silence of the Lambs
filmingLocation: Bimini Airport, South Bimini Island, Bimini Islands, Bahamas
description: A young F.B.I. cadet must receive the help of an incarcerated and manipulative cannibal killer to help catch another serial killer, a madman who skins his victims.

title: Inglourious Basterds
filmingLocation: Brasserie La Renaissance, 112 rue Championnet, Paris 18, Paris, France
description: In Nazi-occupied France during World War II, a plan to assassinate Nazi leaders by a group of Jewish U.S. soldiers coincides with a theatre owner's vengeful plans for the same.
